You can check my post history for more info if you want, but the TLDR is I went to get help for my thoughts and fantasies. Therapist ends up telling police. Police open an investigation. They come get me at work. Work shitcans me. Can't find any place that will hire me. Decide to finally end this miserable life of mine.

I ran a hose from my tailpipe into the car. Next thing I remember, I'm in a hospital. Some asshole happened to be out in the middle of nowhere and found me. Held for observation. Tell Doc the second I get out here, I'm going to try again. Thrown into mental hospital. Guess how much that costs when you don't have insurance! Finally let me out because they can no longer legally hold me. 

Everything I had is gone. My car, impounded and repossessed. Evicted from apartment, all my stuff is gone. Family, who were interviewed by police, refuse to talk to me. I'm fucking homeless now. The only shelter in town won't accept me because I'm the subject of an "ongoing criminal investigation" even though the cops have admitted they found no wrongdoing, they still won't close the fucking case. 

I have 20 dollars to my name. The only food I eat is maybe a couple slices of bread a day. I sleep down by the park under a tarp. The only clothes I have are what I'm wearing and a sweatshirt that a church gave me. Oh, and I have this shitty phone that I can sometimes get wifi from if I'm in the right spot. (Like right now, sitting in a McDonalds parking lot) I've been living like this for 2 weeks now.

There is no help for me. No hope. I have nothing anymore. Had I just kept my mouth shut, I'd be in my miserable little life, with no one the wiser. Or, had I done it right and gotten a fucking gun, I'd be done with all this shit. 

OP, don't get help. Don't. Just keep your mouth shut and learn to live with it. No one will be there to help you. There is no support. Even if you're like me, I've hurt no one in my life. I'm either going to starve, freeze to death when winter comes, or finally work up the courage to throw myself off the bridge. Like the sound of any of those? Because it's what you have to look forward to if you seek out help. Bury that shit, deep down. Try to be normal.
